[b]NEW! Weapon Elements[/b]

Generic weapons felt arbitrary and lackluster.  So we're introducing the concept of Elements to weapons.  Elements are randomly assigned attributes to all weapons during a run.  Once 3 weapons possessing the same element are acquired, that element effect becomes active.  Our intent is to introduce more variety between runs and adds another layer of depth when deciding what generic weapons to grab along the way.

[h2]Endless Leaderboard[/h2]
It's definitely fun to beat your best record in Endless, but now it's time to truly be #1.  Endless records (both Solo and Co-op) are now posted to the Top 100 leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42717676/9c734aa56d27f74dccdcc312ee5898c5bf5d156a.png[/img]

[h2]Pausing[/h2]
Long overdue is a new pause screen. Newer players need a way to see what items do after they initially obtain it. This new pause screen hopefully will help newer players become more familiar with items. Older players may find it useful as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42717676/902db52bb691635c9478a2a6a157ce5b9b3f79d3.png[/img]

[h2]Cards[/h2]
Based on player feedback, we see that many players want to know what cards they have collected or have yet to collect from a pack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42717676/9e37215651b617b577cb1a1669d43fc21b386612.png[/img]
[list][*]Owned/unowned cards for each pack are now visible in the [b]Market[/b].[/list]
[h2]Coin economy[/h2]
Many players have an insanely large amount of coins stockpiled. We also recognize that some players have a harder time collecting coins.
[list][*]Base coin drop rate moderately increased.[/list]
[h2]Stage difficulty[/h2]
Everytime a new stage is released, it is the hardest stage at that time. The game originally had only one stage. This makes every stage very difficult over time. We do want to have a nice progression in terms of difficulty as players progress to the next stage. Expect more balance changes in the future.

[*][b]Forest's Hops[/b] nerfed.
[*][b]Bedrock's Sonny[/b] nerfed
[/list]
[h2]Badge page and Deck naming[/h2]
Players have also voiced their desire to rename badge pages and decks for a better experience when switching between builds.
[list][*]Players can now name their badge pages and decks[/list]

notes.title: Version a.7.0.0
notes.content:
[h2]News[/h2]
It's been a while!  Life has been busy for our small team.  But we're excited to announce the latest update.

In the current state of the game, most progression happens outside of a run.
[list]
[*] Badges
[*] Bonds
[*] Trinkets
[/list]We wanted to introduce another layer of growth [b]throughout[/b] the run.

[b]Introducing - Cards[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42717676/8124785b130fecebe39b2d2c2f6fa828aa7ccafb.png[/img]

[b]"How do they work?"[/b]

Great question! During a run, you will now [b]draw a card[/b] from your [b]Deck[/b].  This happens every 5 levels until your deck runs out of cards.  Each card has an effect that applies once drawn.

Currently a maximum of 10 cards can be added to your deck, accessed via Vault > Cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42717676/9126e8ba3b34db809be7052d28b426a308b1154b.png[/img]

[b]"Enough chit-chat! How do I get them?"[/b]

Card packs can be purchased in the Market.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42717676/dcb5cdfc7e05715bf11ad200a61376b1aa57ccec.png[/img]

After purchasing a pack, you will randomly pull 5 cards of differing rarities.
[list]
[*] Common
[*] Uncommon
[*] Rare
[*] Super Rare
[*] Legendary
[/list]
As more cards are added to the game, you can expect crazy and interesting interactions/abilities.  Have fun trying to collect them all! 

As always, big thanks to the Mobmania community!

- copun

notes.title: Version a.3.0.0
notes.content:
[h1]What's NEW in Version a.3.0.0[/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW! Quests[/b] mechanic.
[*] [b]NEW! Stage Unlock[/b] mechanic.
[*] [b]NEW! Melody[/b] character.

[*] [b]NEW! [/b] spectating when dead.
[*] [b]NEW! Superstar Kevin, Salem, Senna, Julia, and Amber[/b] skins.
[*] [b]NEW! Rogue Draco[/b] skin.
[*] [b]Salem[/b]'s kit has been given a much need buff.
[*] Bosses now drop one reroll.
[*] Many UI elements have been overhauled.
[*] It is now easier to tell what badges you do/don't own from the Black Market badge coupons.
[*] [b]Leo[/b] ammo HUD added.
[*] [b]JM[/b] ammo HUD added.
[*] [b]Wolf's Momentum[/b] no longer reduces [b]Combo Attack's[/b] cooldown.
[*] The large damage numbers have been updated (give it a try if you're already using small damage numbers).
[*] You can now close the shop with (ESC) or (B).
[*] [b]Final Blow[/b] badge changed to flat execute chance.
[*] [b]Snowcap's[/b] hazard re-enabled.
[*] [b]The Dump's[/b] hazard re-enabled.
[*] Common badges moved from Black Market to Market.
[*] Quick-buy now displays equip description when pressing the hotkey.  Players must now hold down the quick-buy hotkey to buy an upgrade.
[*] A number of boss names have been changed.
[*] [b]Witch[/b] can no longer damage players mid-dash.
[*] The tutorial has been updated to include new features.
[/list]

[h2]NEW! Combat Rework[/h2]
[list]
Weapons and Items have been limited to five (5) each.  As more and more generic weapons get added to the game, full generic weapon builds break game balance.  This change also makes it easier to max out on equips already held.  While it was funny to buy everything in the store, these limits are a huge boost to game balance.  More content will come which will allow players to adjust the number of weapons that can be purchased at the tradeoff of other slots (and vice versa).

Combat numbers have been increased by an order of magnitude.  This helps with integer based computations and small percent-based modifiers not having any effect in some cases (looking at you damage badges).

Combat is something that will continue to evolve as we play test (user feedback is also welcome).
[/list]

[h2]NEW! Base Lobbies[/h2]

[h1]What's NEW in Version a.2.4.0[/h1]

[h2]Ana Rework[/h2]
[b]Ana[/b] was always meant to fill the role of a "bruiser"; however, her previous kit was a Frankenstein of tank/support/utility.  Her new kit features a command dash with minor area of effect damage and overall better synergy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42717676/c3858c157352be4737e4b001b2aed50f1f0e1272.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42717676/8b0dd3b5d57eee90e7bb428963553bcad7f09764.png[/img]

[b]Ana[/b] deals a large amount of damage in a straight line.  Her primary weapon [b]Furry Swipes[/b] can hit multiple enemies.  During boss encounters, try to position as many lesser-mobs between you and bosses to clear out large chunks of enemies while at the same time dealing damage to the boss from a safe distance.

Use [b]Pounce[/b] immediately after [b]Furry Swipes[/b] triggers [b]Cat Pose[/b] to immediately trigger again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42717676/957868900b3df4f3707082803122cfdae80cb24e.png[/img]

Each badge has an associated cost in order to equip it. The number of badges at that can equipped is limited by the number of points available. Equipping a badge does not permanently consume points. Points can be refunded by unequipping a badge.

[h2](BONUS)[/h2]
[h2]Developer Insight - A More Roguelike Experience[/h2]
Mobmania follows two core design pillars:
[list]
[*] A challenging experience.
[*] "No catchup required" multiplayer.
[/list]In order to provide a challenging experience, Mobmania forgoes "full-fledged" meta-progression.  Many similar games already offer a meta-progression experience, which is a design choice that tailors the game's difficulty to all skill levels. In those games, the game gets much easier the longer you play as you earn/unlock upgrades. In direct contrast, Mobmania aims to test creativity, reflexes, and teamwork, not how many hours you spend playing. 

Often times, games with "full-fledged" meta-progression fall-short in allowing newcomers to share in the experience with veteran players.  A crude example would be a new player of an MMO attempting to play with a friend who is a long-time player.  A newcomer would not meet the minimum criteria in terms of stats/gear to engage in the same content that would benefit a veteran player.  Similarly, the veteran player has little incentive to engage in newcomer-friendly content as those rewards have already been out-scaled.  Mobmania tries to accommodate players both new and old in playing together - since the minor upgrades/enhancements present are not absolutely necessary to complete content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42717676/3c3065acbcbbf114e8f496b6c8083d5a928c4941.gif[/img]

Lucy previously struggled with handling large amounts of mobs since her kit revolves around maintaining a specific distance from mobs.  Missing a tipper would cause the number of mobs to snowball as she lacked the room to properly space her attacks.  We're updating her kit to provide more mobility and wave clearing potential.  Her new kit still has a focus on spacing and timing, but we've given her extra tools to catch up even if she misses a tipper here and there.

[h3]Beginner Lucy Tips:[/h3]
By design, Lucy is a character that relies on dealing high amounts of critical damage and has a high skill ceiling.  Typically, landing a critical hit is determined by the player's critical chance percentage.  Unique to Lucy, her weapon Tipper will be a guaranteed critical hit if enemies are only within the tip of the strike.

notes.title: Steam Ver. 09.10.2022r1: THE MARKET IS OPEN
notes.content:
What's NEW in Steam Ver. 09.10.2022r1:

[h1]THE MARKET IS OPEN[/h1]

Mobs now have a chance to drop Mobmania Coins, currency accepted at The Market.  These coins can be used to unlock various things such as Characters, Skins (yup, they're here now), Trinkets, and eventually more.

A big concern for us has been the difficulty of the game, especially for players new to the genre.  To address this (as well as choice paralysis) we have hand-selected characters we recommend.  While difficult characters may be fun to start off with, we hope to see more players consistently taking home a crown.  Stop by the Discord for tips.  It's also the best place to report any bugs/glitches (we try to fix them ASAP).

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Market
[*]Skins
[*]Trinkets
[*]Rich Presence (Friend In-game status)
[*]In-game Stats (Press Tab)
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Various visual and bug fixes.
[/list]
[i]Don't worry, your crowns and achievements should still be there![/i]
